title: BigP3BCI Study N — 9x8 dry/wet electrode comparison (8 ALS subjects)
description: This derivative dataset presents EEG recordings from 8 ALS patients participating in the BigP3BCI Study N, a P300-based brain-computer interface investigation comparing 9x8 dry and wet electrode configurations. The study comprises 2 sessions per subject with visual speller paradigm stimuli recorded at 256 Hz using 16-channel EEG montage. This subset is part of the larger BigP3BCI initiative, the most comprehensive public P300 BCI dataset encompassing ~267 subjects across 20 studies.
methods_description: EEG data were acquired at 256 Hz sampling rate using 16 channels in standard 1020 montage with g.USBamp hardware (g.tec). The P300 paradigm employed a 9x8 character grid with visual stimulus presentation. Subjects performed 2 sessions each, with target and non-target event classifications. HED 8.4.0 event annotations were applied to classify sensory and experimental stimulus events.
